# ADR-3002: A01: Function-level authorization gate for admin action 2

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Function-level gaps expose privileged operations to authenticated users.

## Decision

Administrative endpoints MUST NOT execute without a function-level authorization gate for admin action 2 (A01-2).

## Consequences

Authorization failures return 403 without leaking existence details.
